title: SLSK: Make items unsigned again
description:
According to https://nicotine-plus.org/doc/SLSKPROTOCOL.html
which is actively updated (as recently as 2026-01-17), these
are all unsigned. In pratice, they really shouldn't be at the
point where that matter, but logically they all refer to values
that don't make sense as negatives. This reverts
commit e22da97fd159965069fccb4b62feb5c33e906075

Remove the tests against the reported length, because that isn't
necessary (and the captured length is tested anyway inside
check_slsk_format).

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
